result.summary: No critical visual breakage found. The layout is largely intact, with 2 minor clipping issues at the screen edges and above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Right edge content is clipped: the last category chip is half-visible and the third 'Fastest near you' card name is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol'
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal end-padding and a scroll fade indicator so carousel peeking looks intentional and text is not cut mid-word

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name or details visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset above the tab bar so list items are not obscured when scrolling
